rounds.text: ARCIIL is currently trading at a significant discount to its intrinsic value, with a DCF analysis suggesting a margin of safety of 48.6% [E37, E38, E51]. This undervaluation is further evidenced by a price-to-book ratio of 0.65x, which sits far below the sector benchmark of 2.58x [E2, E7]. While current annual performance metrics are muted, the company has demonstrated a strong historical track record with a 5-year median return on equity of 24% [E20, E21]. The market price currently implies an earnings growth rate of only 9.1%, which is notably conservative compared to the 18.0% growth assumed in the base case DCF model [E39]. Conceded: the company currently offers a 0.00% dividend yield and has seen its ROE decline to 4.4% in the most recent period [E4, E13, E22]. Despite these recent headwinds, the stock is trading at a P/E ratio of 20.83x, which is lower than the sector benchmark of 23.75x [E6].
